name: workflow_list
description:
List all workflow definitions in this project. Returns an array of summaries including id, name, description, and node/edge counts.

Use this to:
  • Discover existing workflow IDs before calling workflow_get, workflow_run, or workflow_delete
  • Verify that a chosen id does not already exist before calling workflow_create
  • Get an overview of available workflows to decide which to run or modify
